title: Summary of Plan Features: Veterans' Group Life Insurance (VGLI)
content:
# Veterans' Group Life Insurance (VGLI) — Summary of Plan Features

Veterans' Group Life Insurance (VGLI) is renewable term life insurance. This summary lists, for each coverage tier, the features the policy has and does not have: how it renews, the increase option, conversion, cash value, loans, dividends, and holding VALife at the same time.

## Feature table

| Feature | VGLI $50,000 Coverage | VGLI $100,000 Coverage | VGLI $200,000 Coverage | VGLI $300,000 Coverage | VGLI $400,000 Coverage | VGLI $500,000 Coverage |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Renews for life while premiums are paid | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Length of each renewable term | 5 years | 5 years | 5 years | 5 years | 5 years | 5 years |
| Increase available at each increase anniversary without health questions (USD) | 25000 | 25000 | 25000 | 25000 | 25000 | 25000 |
| Years between increase anniversaries | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 |
| Age after which no further increases are available | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Conversion to an individual commercial policy | allowed | allowed | allowed | allowed | allowed | allowed |
| Proof of good health required to convert | no | no | no | no | no | no |
| Cash value | none | none | none | none | none | none |
| Policy loans | not available | not available | not available | not available | not available | not available |
| Dividends | not paid | not paid | not paid | not paid | not paid | not paid |
| VALife may be held together with VGLI | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |

## What the table means for an insured

- **Term and renewal.** Coverage runs in renewable terms of 5 years each and renews for life as long as premiums are paid.
- **Increases.** At each increase anniversary, which comes every 5 years, an increase of $25,000 is available without health questions. After age 60, no further increases are available.
- **Conversion.** Coverage can be converted to an individual commercial policy, and conversion does not require proof of good health.
- **Savings features.** The policy builds no cash value, cannot be borrowed against, and pays no dividends.
- **VALife.** An insured may hold VALife together with VGLI.

## Points of reference

- *Does any VGLI tier build a cash value that could be borrowed against?* No tier builds cash value, and no tier offers a policy loan.
- *Is the increase amount larger on a larger tier?* No. The increase available at an anniversary is $25,000 on every tier.
- *Is health evidence needed to convert on a higher tier?* No. Conversion requires no proof of good health on any tier.
